name: Sequoia-X
description: A股自动选股系统 — 多种技术形态自动扫描，收盘后自动运行并推送飞书
one_liner: An automated stock-screener for the Chinese A-share market that scans price charts every evening after the market closes and pings your phone (via a Chinese chat app) with picks matching classic trading patterns.
buyer: An individual retail day-trader in mainland China who currently screens stocks manually and wants automated signals delivered after close without paying for an expensive terminal.
business_use_cases: A retail trader runs it on a home server to get a nightly shortlist of breakout candidates before the next trading day.
A small trading-education channel uses its signals as free content to attract students to a paid course.
A part-time quant hobbyist forks the strategies as a base for their own backtesting experiments.

money_ideas.idea: Package it as a hosted signal service with a monthly fee, handling the server/backfill/notification setup for non-technical traders.

steal_this: Run the backfill once on a cheap VPS this weekend, wire it to your own Feishu/Telegram, and use the daily picks as free content to build a trading newsletter audience — but be upfront that trading-signal tools carry real regulatory and liability risk in most markets.
